budgetPolicy: Each host class's budgets come from two pnpm bench:kernel runs on that class's measurement host. Each latency budget bounds p95 at three times the worse measured p95, rounded up; the append-throughput budget bounds the median at one third of the lower measured median, rounded down. The threefold headroom absorbs run-to-run noise and a loaded machine; it is not a claim about any other host. macos-arm64-apfs: set on 2026-09-18 on the reference host (Apple M4 Pro, 14 cores, 48 GiB, Darwin 27.0.0, APFS, Node 24.17.0, SQLite 3.53.0). linux-arm64-overlayfs-container: set on 2026-09-23 from two runs as the unprivileged node user in a Debian 12 (bookworm) Node 24.21.0 container (bundled SQLite 3.53.4) in OrbStack's Linux VM (kernel 7.0.14-orbstack, 14 CPUs, 16 GiB) on the same reference host, temporary directory on the container's overlayfs; rounded up (down for throughput) to two significant figures.

hostClasses.description: macOS on Apple silicon (arm64) with the benchmark temporary directory on APFS

Linux on arm64 with the benchmark temporary directory on overlayfs (filesystem type 0x794c7630), as in a container. Measured in a Linux container in OrbStack's virtual machine on the macOS arm64 reference host; any linux/arm64 host with an overlayfs temporary directory matches, but the budgets are only evidence for that measurement host
